title: I built a browser MOBA by hand in 2022. Coding agents helped me finally get it playable.
author: No-Replacement6533
selftext:
Hey all! In 2022 I started building something like League of Legends in the browser. I built the initial version by hand, got partway through it, and then it sat unfinished for a few years. It was a ton of work, and coding agents gave me the boost I needed to finally get it done.



It's called Splitpush.io. It's a free 2v2 game with lanes, minions, towers, and geometric characters. You earn gold and branch into different builds, closer to Diep.io than buying a full inventory of items.



I used the agents to read and modernize the old codebase, work on multiplayer and bots, and then iterate on the abilities and interface while I played. A lot of the useful work came from really specific feedback. Shade's sword looked like it hit people while I chased them, but the damage timing didn't match the animation. That needed a fix to the actual hit timing, not just a nicer effect.



Bastion was another big change. It started with a projectile, shield, dash, and a targeted area ultimate. I kept coming back to the idea that the hexagon should spin and damage people around it. The spinning paths made the character much more fun to play. Vector went in the opposite direction: a squishy triangle with rapid-fire builds and an ultimate that shoots from all three corners.



That's been most of the process: play, find something that feels bad, describe it, change it, and play again. The agents helped with implementation and tests, but deciding whether the fights actually felt good took a lot of playing. I'm really excited to see what people outside the small testing group think.



You can try it at [https://splitpush.io/](https://splitpush.io/) on a desktop browser with a mouse and keyboard. No download or account needed. Bots fill empty spots, and there are custom lobbies for friends. It's still an alpha. The attached clip is gameplay against bots.



Servers are in California right now, so ping will be higher if you're farther away. If more people start playing from other regions, I'll spin up servers there too.



I also made a free skin for the first testers: click Shards on the home screen, then Redeem a code, and enter FIRSTWAVE. It works for guests too.
